findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_remote_jobs, get_feedback_reply · Public sink: find_remote_jobs, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_remote_jobs, get_feedback_reply · Public sink: find_remote_jobs, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
